source: the installed source checkout at ~/lanes/qwen-image-21/sglang/src/python/sglang — multimodal_gen/runtime/server_args/server_args.py (the ServerArgs dataclass `sglang serve --help` renders) and multimodal_gen/runtime/entrypoints/openai/protocol.py::ImageGenerationsRequest for the per-request knobs
notes: Defaults are the dataclass fields of THIS build, not the documentation. Three things are worth knowing before reading a fingerprint made from them. (1) --component-quantizations.<component> is real but invisible: it does not appear in `sglang serve --help`, because ServerArgs._extract_component_quantizations() pulls it out of argparse's unknown args. (2) Every placement default is null on purpose — the auto memory policy decides offloading from the free device memory at load time, so the same flags produce a different peak on a busy box than on an idle one, and a null default is never dropped from the fingerprint, which is the safe direction. (3) The attention backend is null for the same reason: SM120-class parts fall back to Torch SDPA whatever is selected. Only a curated subset of ServerArgs' ~200 fields is listed: everything that can move a number on a single-GPU image run, plus the path and port fields that must be present so they can be dropped.

params.name: model-path
params.help: Checkpoint directory or HF id. Dropped from the fingerprint.

params.name: model-id
params.help: Name used to look the pipeline config up in the registry; without it the loader infers one from the path.

params.name: served-model-name
params.help: Name the OpenAI routes answer to. Dropped from the fingerprint.

params.name: revision
params.help: Checkpoint revision. Dropped from the fingerprint.

params.name: trust-remote-code
params.help: Allow custom code from the checkpoint repo.

params.name: host
params.help: Dropped from the fingerprint.

params.name: port
params.help: Dropped from the fingerprint.

params.name: output-path
params.help: Where rendered files are written before being returned. Dropped from the fingerprint.

params.name: backend
params.help: auto prefers the sglang-native implementation and falls back to the vanilla diffusers pipeline.

params.name: attention-backend
params.help: Resolved from the device at startup when unset. On SM120-class parts, which is what GB10 is, the selection falls back to Torch SDPA.

params.name: enable-attention-backend-autotune
params.help: Benchmark the available attention backends at startup and keep the fastest.

params.name: component-attention-backends
params.help: Per-component override of the attention backend.

params.name: num-gpus
params.help: Devices the pipeline is spread over.

params.name: tp-size
params.help: Tensor parallel size; derived from num-gpus when unset.

params.name: dp-size
params.help: Data parallel size.

params.name: sp-degree
params.help: Sequence parallel degree; derived when unset.

params.name: ulysses-degree
params.help: Ulysses sequence-parallel degree.

params.name: ring-degree
params.help: Ring attention degree.

params.name: enable-cfg-parallel
params.help: Run the two classifier-free-guidance branches on separate devices. Irrelevant at guidance 1, which is this model's own setting.

params.name: cfg-parallel-degree
params.help: Devices for the CFG split.

params.name: encoder-parallel
params.help: How the text/image encoders are sharded.

params.name: base-gpu-id
params.help: First device index.

params.name: performance-mode
params.help: Preset that moves several placement and compile defaults at once.

params.name: quantization
params.help: Whole-pipeline quantization override. Per-component is the form the Qwen-Image-2.1 recipe uses.

params.name: quantization-ignored-layers
params.help: Layers kept at full precision by the whole-pipeline override.

params.name: component-quantizations.transformer
params.help: Online quantization of the DiT, e.g. fp8. NOTE: this spelling does not appear in `sglang serve --help`; ServerArgs._extract_component_quantizations() pulls --component-quantizations.<name> out of argparse's UNKNOWN args. The server echoes it back in server_args and the loader logs 'Using quantization override fp8 for transformer'.

params.name: component-quantizations.text_encoder
params.help: Online quantization of the Qwen3-VL 8B text encoder, e.g. fp8. Same undocumented extraction path as the transformer form.

params.name: component-quantization-ignored-layers
params.help: Per-component list of layers kept at full precision.

params.name: component-precisions
params.help: Per-component dtype override.

params.name: component-paths.transformer
params.help: Directory with config.json + weights + quant metadata for a serialized (ModelOpt FP8/NVFP4) component. Switches the config and the loader, not just the tensors.

params.name: component-weights-paths.transformer
params.help: A single GGUF holding the whole component, with native tensor names. Accepts owner/repo/file.gguf and owner/repo:QUANT_TYPE.

params.name: transformer-weights-path
params.help: Raw weights-only override for the DiT.

params.name: nunchaku-config
params.help: SVDQuant loader, selected by the svdq-(int4|fp4)_r{rank} filename; gated to SM8x or SM12x, so GB10 is allowed.

params.name: component-residency
params.help: Which components stay resident on the device.

params.name: cpu-offload-components
params.help: Components offloaded to host memory wholesale.

params.name: dit-cpu-offload
params.help: Offload the DiT; decided by the auto memory policy when unset.

params.name: dit-layerwise-offload
params.help: Stream the DiT layer by layer; decided by the auto memory policy when unset.

params.name: layerwise-offload-components
params.help: Components streamed layer by layer. Left unset, the auto memory policy picks them from the free device memory at load, which is why the same build gives different peaks on a busy and an idle box.

params.name: dit-offload-prefetch-size
params.help: Layers prefetched ahead of the DiT's current layer.

params.name: dit-layerwise-resident-layers
params.help: Layers of the DiT kept permanently resident.

params.name: dit-layerwise-residency-policy
params.help: Which layers stay resident when only some do.

params.name: text-encoder-cpu-offload
params.help: Decided by the auto memory policy when unset.

params.name: image-encoder-cpu-offload
params.help: Decided by the auto memory policy when unset.

params.name: vae-cpu-offload
params.help: Offload the VAE to host memory.

params.name: direct-gpu-weight-loading
params.help: Load weights straight onto the device instead of through host memory.

params.name: use-fsdp-inference
params.help: Shard with FSDP at inference.

params.name: pin-cpu-memory
params.help: Pin the host-side copy. On unified memory a pinned copy holds the same bytes twice, and the build says so in its own log.

params.name: offload-during-compile
params.help: Keep offloading active while torch.compile traces.

params.name: enable-torch-compile
params.help: torch.compile the DiT.

params.name: regional-compile
params.help: Compile per region instead of the whole graph.

params.name: enable-breakable-cuda-graph
params.help: Capture CUDA graphs that can be broken out of.

params.name: cache-dit-config
params.help: Step-caching config (reuses DiT output across steps); changes the picture, not just the speed.

params.name: disable-autocast
params.help: Turn off autocast in the pipeline.

params.name: warmup-mode
params.help: Render a throwaway image at startup so the first real request is not measuring compilation.

params.name: warmup-steps
params.help: Steps used by the warmup render.

params.name: warmup-resolutions
params.help: Resolutions warmed up.

params.name: batching-mode
params.help: How concurrent requests are grouped. Irrelevant at concurrency 1, which is what every image workload runs at.

params.name: batching-max-size
params.help: Largest batch the scheduler will form.

params.name: batching-delay-ms
params.help: How long the scheduler waits to fill a batch.

params.name: lora-path
params.help: LoRA adapter.

params.name: lora-scale
params.help: LoRA merge scale.

params.name: enable-metrics
params.help: Prometheus endpoint.

params.name: num-inference-steps
params.help: Per-request. Falls back to the pipeline config's own value when absent; every workload here sends 40.

params.name: guidance-scale
params.help: Per-request. This engine's spelling of the canonical guidance parameter; vLLM-Omni calls the same thing true_cfg_scale, so the two lanes are comparable only at the effective value, never at the raw flag.

params.name: true-cfg-scale
params.help: Per-request. Distinct from guidance-scale on distilled pipelines.

params.name: flow-shift
params.help: Per-request. Unset leaves the scheduler's own shift.

params.name: negative-prompt
params.help: Per-request. Only does anything above guidance 1.

params.name: background
params.help: Per-request. transparent asks for an alpha channel; this is the only transparency knob this lane has.

params.name: output-format
params.help: Per-request, png/jpeg/webp; the sampling params class picks a default per model.

params.name: response-format
params.help: Per-request. The harness asks for b64_json so nothing is left on the server's disk.

params.name: generator-device
params.help: Per-request. Which device the seeded torch generator lives on — seed semantics differ between engines partly because of this.

params.name: enable-teacache
params.help: Per-request step caching.

params.name: max-sequence-length
params.help: Per-request cap on the encoded prompt.

params.name: enable-upscaling
params.help: Per-request post-hoc upscale; would make a size number mean something else.
